Rescan Detectors

After placing your completed detector directory into detectors/, click rescan so the gateway discovers it.

Quick Start Guide

  1. Download and extract to detectors/
  2. Clone your model repo into detectors/<name>/repo/
  3. Edit detector.py — implement initialize() and detect()
  4. Edit manifest.json — fill in model metadata
  5. Edit requirements.txt — add your dependencies
  6. Click Rescan Detectors above to discover the new detector
  7. Build & start via the Detectors page
